overture._comment: Open-licensed POI layer (CDLA-Permissive). The snapshot is produced out-of-band by tools/extract_overture.py and committed; the pipeline only reads it. bbox is [min_lat, min_lng, max_lat, max_lng] (same as overpass.bbox). exclude_categories drops home-prone trades (Overture has no home flag -- blunt proxy; set [] to disable).

dedupe._comment: Proximity dedup threshold (metres): same normalized name within this distance collapses to one marker. 120 m collapses cross-source OSM/Overture double-pins while keeping genuinely distinct same-name locations (which are >120 m apart).
